scientific_question: Can the two remaining independent Wave-3 methods be bound to complete, immutable, locally auditable official source trees before adapter design?
decision_informed: Whether MemoryOS and MemGAS are eligible to enter separate fail-closed WMA lifecycle adapter prefreezes.
scientific_evidence_role: engineering source-identity gate only; no lifecycle, benchmark, or paper-result claim is permitted
prior_evidence: The current MemoryOS official remote HEAD and existing clean local checkout both resolved to 587ed7755c7aed179965792830ff1b5ad9a6fa92.
The current MemGAS official remote HEAD resolved to c2d4e9fdc331074802a711baf4371197f9194399.
The OmniMem identity audit reduced Wave-3 to the two independent methods MemoryOS and MemGAS.

required_checks: origin URL matches the official repository
tracked files are inventoried by path, byte size, and SHA-256
no model weight or unresolved Git LFS file is presented as source code

execution_contract.server_root_injection: Set AGENT_ENHANCE_REMOTE_ROOT immediately before execution; it must resolve to a writable project root named AgentEnhance under /data1 or /data2.
execution_contract.network: ordinary git HTTPS clone of the exact public source repository; no model or dataset download

admission_rule: The exact commit is detached, clean, and matches the frozen repository.
All tracked regular files have retained relative paths, byte sizes, and SHA-256 values.
The source contains no submodule, unresolved Git LFS pointer, or model-like weight file.
The source and evidence roots were absent before execution and remain unique.
The evidence root contains TERMINAL_ACCEPTED, no TERMINAL_REJECTED, and a verified evidence inventory.
failure_rule: Any collision, clone error, identity mismatch, dirty state, submodule, LFS pointer, weight-like file, byte-ceiling breach, or timeout seals the fresh evidence root TERMINAL_REJECTED. Preserve the partial source and do not retry or repair it in place.
wave1_non_interference: Do not download or load any model.
Do not start, stop, inspect through, or alter any Wave-1 service process.
Do not change CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES or create a GPU process.
Do not write beneath any Wave-1 run, dataset, environment, service, or archive root.
next_gate_after_acceptance: Independently audit both source inventories, then design separate MemoryOS and MemGAS WMA lifecycle adapters. Source acceptance alone never authorizes numerical execution.
prohibited_actions: using a moving branch name as an execution identity
using official reported scores as local reproduction values
starting a lifecycle or numerical run from this gate
deleting a rejected or partial source root
